title.en: Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2009

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2009 and shall come into operation on 1st July 2009.
3. The Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (Composition of Offences) Regulations (Cap. 41, Rg 3) are revoked.
